attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2277560)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Wuchang:_Fallen_Feathers
Fandom (wuchang-fallen-feathers.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://wuchang-fallen-feathers.fandom.com/wiki/Wuchang:_Fallen_Feathers
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub). Its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents pages are linked but none is written; it has no subpages at all. wuchang.fandom.com and wuchangfallenfeathers.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; wuchang-fallen-feathers.fandom.com answers, with "WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers" redirecting to "Wuchang: Fallen Feathers", which has 5 linked pages ("Feathering", "Red Mercury", "Shu", "Weapons", "Wuchang"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema names the game "WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers" (app 2277560). 25 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden; most are named "title - name" in a boss style (for example "Commander - Honglan"), and all sit in the main story chapter. Hidden 2 to 5 ("Dream's Sweet Deceit", "Successor of the Bo", "Bound by Fate's Threads", "Jarful of Medicine") may be endings, but the data does not say. "Well Met, Divines" (offer blood at a shrine) went to upgrades; "Radiant Faith" (every shrine) went to collectibles. Only 4 chapters, because the visible achievements cover few themes.
